page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-44-highlssd is a memory-optimized and storage-intensive server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor. This x86_64 architecture system features 44 vCPUs derived from 22 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 352 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. The server includes 19326 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across six drives, but lacks any dedicated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in specific multi-threaded and cryptographic workloads. The server achieves a strong rating in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 231.48 GB/sec and PassMark CPU encryption at 38504.45. Image processing performance is also strong, scoring 15970.0 on Geekbench. However, most general compute tasks, including stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark database operations, fall within the average range.

While the system handles prompt processing for medium 7B LLM models with strong performance, text generation for large 70B models is poor, registering at 2.36 tokens/sec due to the lack of GPU acceleration. This hardware profile is highly cost-efficient for memory-dense and local storage-heavy workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for large-scale databases, memory-intensive data processing, and high-throughput local storage operations.
